results.title: Medical Devices; Guidance for Industry — Software as a Medical Device
results.abstract: FDA is issuing guidance on software as a medical device (SaMD). This guidance discusses the regulatory framework for SaMD, including premarket notification requirements.

results.title: 510(k) Premarket Notification Submissions for Device Software Functions
results.abstract: Final guidance document describing the information needed in a 510(k) submission for device software functions.
